WELCOME TO THE TACO DRAMA

Procter & Gamble is making television again.

TALEX MEDIA SWIPE →
NEARLY 100 YEARS AGO

P&G invented the soap opera as a branded content play.

1933 They put Oxydol, their laundry soap, behind a radio serial called Ma Perkins. It ran more than 7,000 episodes.
1952 Guiding Light moved to CBS television and ran for 72 years.
THE MODEL Instead of buying 30 seconds inside someone else's show, P&G owned the program outright.
WHY IT WORKED

They owned the program to build a relationship with their audience.

THE AUDIENCE Stay-at-home moms who valued the stories every afternoon.
THE BUYERS The same women deciding what soap their home used.

When it came time to buy detergent, loyal listeners of Ma Perkins reached for Oxydol first.

WHY NOW

P&G is doing it again with Rico's Tacos, a family building a taco stand outside an Albertsons, two minutes at a time.

$14B Where Omdia expects vertical short drama to land by the end of 2026, up from $11B in 2025.
OMDIA, GLOBAL VERTICAL SHORT-DRAMA REVENUE 04 / 08
YOUR TURN

You don't have P&G's budget or 2,000 stores. You don't need either.

01 Understand one group of people well enough to make something they would choose to watch.
02 Make it episodic, because a series earns a return visit and a one-off never does.
03 Keep making it long after the novelty wears off, which is where most companies tap out.
Build Your Legend. 05 / 08
THE PAYOFF

The benefits show up where your C-Suite cares.

SALES Walks into warmer conversations because people already know your voice.
SUPPORT Answers the same five questions with a link instead of a PDF nobody opens.
RECRUITING Candidates see how you actually operate before they apply.
THE LIBRARY Every episode becomes part of a content library you own.
06 / 08
LEADING WITH VALUE

Value covers more ground than another white paper.

If you make somebody laugh on a Tuesday, you gave them value. If you get them invested in whether a family's taco stand makes it, you gave them value.

Attention you earn beats attention you rent, because it arrives with a little trust already attached.
